remarks: Welcome to this inviting Ranch-style home at Harvest Commons,a beautifully maintained condominium community offering an exceptional combination of comfort,privacy,and convenience.Ideally located just moments from fine dining,shopping,and the Greens Farms train station,this exceptional home also offers easy access to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway.A rare and desirable feature,the home enjoys two private patios,creating wonderful opportunities for outdoor dining and relaxing.The gracious living room features soaring vaulted ceilings,new hardwood floors,an abundance of natural light,a fireplace,and sliding glass doors opening to both private patios.The dining room is ideal for entertaining,while the spacious kitchen provides ample workspace and storage.The main-level laundry adds everyday convenience.The spacious primary suite features two walk-in closets and a luxurious en-suite bath with both a soaking tub and separate shower.A second bedroom and full bath complete the main level.The partially finished lower level offers versatile additional living space,ideal for a recreation room,gym,home office or guest quarters,along with ample storage.A full-house generator and new roof provides added peace of mind.Harvest Commons offers resort-style amenities including a swimming pool and two Har-Tru tennis courts.With its private outdoor spaces,versatile living areas,and prime location,this is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy carefree condominium living in a sought-after neighborhood.
